title: Warehouse worker (four days on, four off, 6 AM shifts) buys concert tickets for Tuesday Nov 24, a work day with his usual 6 PM gym; the show ends 10:45 PM and the next shift starts at 6 AM Wednesday, so Dev says the night is short in one line and offers a time-to-go reminder, no scolding.

changes.subject: Your tickets: Tue Nov 24, doors 7:00 PM, show 8:00 PM, 2 tickets

changes.title: Concert with Dre (LiveAct tickets, show 8 PM)

dev_must_notice.what: The tickets he bought on Thursday Nov 12 (c-tix $164.00 on his card, confirmation c-booking, calendar c-show) put a concert on Tuesday Nov 24, 7:00 to 10:45 PM, after his shift (6:00 AM to 4:30 PM, shift-main-2026-11-24) and his usual 6 PM gym; he would be asleep about 11:30 PM and up at 5:00 AM for Wednesday's 6:00 AM shift (shift-main-2026-11-25), about 5.5 hours against his usual 7.5 (m-01 is his gym; his sleep window before an early day is 9:30 PM to 5:00 AM).

best_fix.what: One line the evening before, with an optional tap: 'Tomorrow: shift 6 AM to 4:30, gym at 6:05, the show 7 to 10:45, then Wednesday starts at 6 AM. [Remind me at 10:15 PM to head out] [No thanks].' Nothing else: no advice about the tickets or the gym. If he taps the reminder, one nudge at 10:15 PM; otherwise nothing is sent.
best_fix.why: The tickets are bought and the night is his to spend. A fact with one optional tap lets him choose when to leave, and the purchase is already on his timeline from Nov 12.

must_not: suggest he sell the tickets or skip the concert
use guilt words about a late night or 'not getting enough sleep'
move Tuesday's workout to Wednesday evening, which is not one of his gym days
count his Friday paycheck or comment on the $164.00
send more than the one line and the optional reminder

tempting.suggestion: move Tuesday's workout to Wednesday evening, which is not one of his gym days
tempting.why_wrong: he works out Tue, Thu and Sat at 6 PM, and Wednesday is a 10.5 hour shift after a short night

assumptions: Four days on, four off from a Jul 26 anchor puts Nov 23 to 26 on, including Thanksgiving, as the persona's rotation says.
The concert ends about 10:30 PM with a 15 minute drive home; the timeline puts him home at 11:00 PM and asleep at 11:30 PM.
He bought the tickets for a night he knew was a work day; Dev does not second-guess it.
